anya: Heads-up: short coordination thread for the console/analytics schema migration — focus on projection sparsity, indexing, and a compact rollback. Need a clear safepoint and lightweight telemetry.
rohan: TL;DR plan?
anya: Dual-write -> compact projection (shadow) -> staged canary -> cutover. Keep projection narrow to avoid index bloat and prefer partial indexes + BRIN for older data.
mike: Agreed. Proposal for projection table: only store (route_id, day, v1_count, v2_count, p50_ms, p95_ms). Keep types tight and partition by day. Use partial btree on hot window + BRIN for history. Example DDL in runbook: ```sql
CREATE TABLE ingest_projection (
  route_id text,
  day date,
  v1_count bigint,
  v2_count bigint,
  p50_ms int,
  p95_ms int,
  PRIMARY KEY (route_id, day)
);
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ix_proj_route_day_hot ON ingest_projection(route_id, day) WHERE day >= current_date - INTERVAL '14 days';
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY brin_proj_event_time ON ingest_events USING brin(event_time);
```
jess: Console UX: show an "experimental data" badge when results come from v2 and a small per-tenant quota-delta card. Keep feature-flagged and add a support escalation at 20% canary.
eva: Telemetry: emit per-route mismatch_ratio and an `ingest_migration_toggle` event. Start deterministic sampling: `hash(route_id)%100 < 1` but always include low-cardinality routes and tenants > 10k tokens/day. Also log full JSON diffs for ~50 random routes/day for manual audits.
rohan: Canary cadence suggestion: 2% for 6h -> 10% for 24h -> 25% for 48h. Abort if mismatch_ratio > 0.02 for routes >1k/day or if console query p95_new/p95_old > 1.25. rollout-bot should auto-pause.
rollout-bot: automated: will run health checks every 5m and POST pause on thresholds :gear:
mike: Reconciliation query for runbook (compact): ```sql
SELECT route_id,
  sum(case when ingest_version='v1' then 1 else 0 end) AS v1_count,
  sum(case when ingest_version='v2' then 1 else 0 end) AS v2_count,
  100.0*(sum(case when ingest_version='v2' then 1 else 0 end) - sum(case when ingest_version='v1' then 1 else 0 end))/GREATEST(1,sum(case when ingest_version='v1' then 1 else 0 end)) AS delta_pct
FROM ingestion_events
WHERE day >= current_date - INTERVAL '2 days'
GROUP BY route_id
HAVING GREATEST(sum(case when ingest_version='v1' then 1 else 0 end), sum(case when ingest_version='v2' then 1 else 0 end)) > 10;
```
anya: Rollback steps for runbook: (1) flip read adapter to v1-only via SQL toggle and admin API, (2) disable dual-write, (3) run reconciliation from safepoint, (4) notify #support and product. Include exact commands: ```sql
UPDATE feature_flags SET value='v1-only' WHERE key='console.ingest.read_mode';
``` and admin API `POST /admin/feature-toggles/console-ingest?mode=v1-only`.
rohan: Safepoint: export routing join keys before cutover: `pg_dump --table=routing_keys --data-only --file=safepoint_routing_$(date +%s).sql` and produce a route_hash CSV to speed diffs.
jess: I'll add the dashboard card and the UI badge. Will also add the support ping step at 20% canary.
mike: I'll add the projection DDL and index samples to the PR and ensure the projection job TTLs old rows (30 days by default).
eva: I'll own telemetry and sampling config, and wire the toggle event.
ingest-bot: automated: shadow-write cron will start 2024-06-18T02:00Z if flags enabled :gear:
anya: I'll author the runbook PR and assign owners: Mike (projection/index + DDL), Jess (UI/dashboard), Eva (telemetry/ingest-bot), Rohan (canary controller), me (runbook + support coord). Planning to enable dual-write Tue AM if no objections.
rohan: small nit: ensure runbook includes exact health-check Grafana panels + alert links so oncall can triage quickly.
anya: Will include links. Tagging this thread for follow-up; PR coming in 30m. Thanks everyone.
